methods.description: Read exact plugin-version exemptions saved in this profile.
methods.returns: Accepted package-name@version keys with the runtime versions they may run on, and any record or file problem the reader rejected, which the caller reports instead of failing.

methods.signature: @Remote setVersionExemption(packageVersion: string, runtimeVersion: string, enabled: boolean, acceptRisk?: boolean): Promise<ChangeResult>
methods.description: Grant or revoke one exact plugin/runtime exemption and reevaluate live plugins.

parameters.name: packageVersion
parameters.description: Exact manifest package name followed by @ and its version; never an installation spec or alias.

parameters.name: runtimeVersion
parameters.description: Exact current DSH version for grants; revocation may name a previous runtime.

parameters.name: enabled
parameters.description: Whether to grant rather than revoke the exemption.

parameters.name: acceptRisk
parameters.description: Required true for grants after the user accepts possible crashes and data loss.

methods.returns: Saved and runtime outcomes. Startup-only profiles require restart.

methods.description: Read current plugins, including why a row cannot be changed through the profile patch.
methods.returns: Current runtime entries with persistent patch targets.

methods.description: Read the profile's installed bundles, the bundles this dsh installation supplies, and the selected names that are not bundles. A dependency without a bundle patch is listed, as a `not-bundle` problem, only while it is selected.
methods.returns: Package versions, manifest descriptions, rows, optional display metadata, activation selections, whether the installation offers the bundle, and removal availability.

methods.description: Read the registries this manager asks: the configured first one, its fallbacks in order, and what pnpm's own configuration names.
methods.returns: The registries in pnpm's comparison form; null is the one pnpm's own configuration names, `resolved` as pnpm reads it now.

methods.signature: @Remote async inspect(spec: string, options?: InspectOptions, signal?: AbortSignal): Promise<PluginSpecInspection>
methods.description: Read what a spec names before installing it.

parameters.name: spec
parameters.description: One package spec: a registry name, an absolute path, a git address, or a tarball.

methods.returns: The package the spec names, or why it is refused.

methods.description: Persist a plugin entry's desired enablement and apply it on live profiles.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Loader entry identity returned by listPlugins.

methods.returns: Saved and runtime outcomes, including higher-priority overrides.

methods.description: Select or remove a bundle layer while retaining installed dependencies.

parameters.name: enabled
parameters.description: Whether the bundle contributes its patch layer.

methods.description: Install a package using the same pnpm implementation as dsh plugin. GitHub repositories get a connection check bounded by githubConnectionTimeoutMs before pnpm starts; only network failures or timeouts stop installation, while pnpm owns authentication and transport fallback. A run that fails, is cancelled, or adds a package without a bundle patch restores `package.json` and `pnpm-lock.yaml` as they were; downloaded files can stay.

parameters.name: spec
parameters.description: One package spec, including local paths relative to the invocation directory.

parameters.name: options
parameters.description: Whether to activate the installed bundle (defaults to true), the request id a cancellation names, the pending build scripts to allow for this profile before pnpm runs, and the registry asked first.

methods.returns: Package-manager diagnostics, the registries asked, and the observed activation outcome.

methods.description: Recover the result of an active installation without cancelling it.

parameters.name: requestId
parameters.description: The id supplied when installation started.

methods.returns: The installation's outcome after it settles, or null if no active request has that id. Completed results are not retained; null establishes neither success nor cancellation.

methods.description: Stop an installation this manager owns and wait until its files are back.

parameters.name: requestId
parameters.description: The id the installation was started with.

methods.returns: `cancelled` once the Git check or pnpm exited and the files are restored, `too-late` once the bundle is being applied, `not-running` for any other id.

methods.description: Unload and remove a profile-owned bundle dependency through dsh plugin's pnpm path.
methods.returns: Removal diagnostics and the remaining profile state.
